name: Word tools
what: Counts the words in some text or a text file, and tidies a list of words.

tools.name: count_words
tools.what: Counts the words, lines and characters in some text.

tools.name: count_file_words
tools.what: Counts the words, lines and characters in a plain text file.

file.description: Full path of a .txt or .md file.

jobs.name: Tidy a word list
jobs.when: Someone asks to tidy, sort or de-duplicate a list of words.
steps: Read the list the person gave you, or the file they named.
Take out empty lines and repeats, ignoring capitals.
Sort what is left from A to Z.
Show the tidy list, and say how many repeats you took out.
